agent_assessment: LPBS API implementation is substantially complete (Phases 1-2 and Phase 4 skills). All 8 core plan requirements for the LPBS API are implemented: schema additions (release_id on artifacts, update_policy on apps), parameterized variant_key in UpsertAsset, requireUpdateAPIKey middleware with constant-time comparison, release notes in manifests, channel discovery endpoint, verification endpoint, update policy CRUD, and release_id storage in artifact commit. All existing tests pass (cached). New tests cover: channel discovery, update policy CRUD, requireUpdateAPIKey middleware, release notes in manifest, non-default variant_key upsert, and ListChannels integration. However, Phase 3 (S2D integration) is NOT implemented: the scenario-to-desktop upload flow does not pass release_id or channel/variant_key to LPBS. The UploadRequest struct, proxyPresign, and proxyApply methods are unchanged. Additionally, test coverage has gaps: no tests for the verification endpoint (handleUpdateVerify) and no tests for release_id round-trip on artifacts.
notes: Phase 3 (S2D Integration) is entirely missing: scenario-to-desktop UploadRequest struct lacks release_id and channel fields, proxy methods don't pass them
Verification endpoint (handleUpdateVerify) has zero test coverage despite being a new endpoint
No test verifies release_id is stored and retrievable on download_artifacts (CommitArtifact round-trip)
landing-page-desktop-upload skill documents channel and verification but omits release_id flow documentation
landing-page-deploy-setup skill correctly documents update_policy configuration
GCT flagged scenario-to-desktop with 229 code quality violations and 0 visual screenshots, but these appear to be pre-existing issues unrelated to this backlog item
All LPBS API tests pass (cached run); no test failures detected

evidence.title: Schema additions in DDL (main.go)
evidence.description: Verified release_id TEXT column on download_artifacts (line 808), index on release_id (line 809), and update_policy JSONB column on download_apps with conservative defaults (line 810). All use ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS / CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS pattern.

evidence.title: UpsertAsset parameterized variant_key (download_service.go)
evidence.description: UpsertAsset at line 562 accepts VariantKey parameter on DownloadAsset struct (line 571), defaults to 'default' if empty (lines 572-573), and uses it in INSERT/upsert (line 612). No hardcoded 'default' in the query.

evidence.title: requireUpdateAPIKey middleware with constant-time comparison
evidence.description: Middleware function at update_handlers.go:53-84 imports crypto/subtle (line 5) and uses subtle.ConstantTimeCompare at line 74. Loads app by app_key, checks if update_api_key is set, validates X-Update-Key header. Applied to update file, channel discovery, and verification endpoints.

evidence.title: Release notes in buildElectronManifest
evidence.description: buildElectronManifest at update_handlers.go:98 accepts releaseNotes parameter. Lines 109-110 conditionally add releaseNotes to YAML manifest when non-empty, omit when empty. Called at line 161 with asset.ReleaseNotes.

evidence.title: Channel discovery endpoint
evidence.description: GET /api/v1/updates/{app_key}/channels implemented at update_handlers.go:204-214. Route registered at line 366-367. Returns ChannelInfo array with channel, platform, version, updated_at. Gated by requireUpdateAPIKey. Service method ListChannels at download_service.go:631-671 maps 'default' variant_key back to 'stable' channel.

evidence.title: Post-release verification endpoint
evidence.description: GET /api/v1/updates/{app_key}/verify implemented at update_handlers.go:231-283. Route registered at line 368-369. Accepts channel, platform, expected_version, deep query params. Returns match, actual_version, actual_sha512, and optional artifact_accessible/presign_valid for deep mode. Gated by requireUpdateAPIKey.

evidence.title: Update policy CRUD endpoint
evidence.description: GET handler at update_handlers.go:302-321, PUT handler at lines 325-359. Routes registered at lines 372-375 under /api/v1/admin/download-apps/{app_key}/update-policy. PUT validates check_interval_hours >= 1 and update_mode in (optional, recommended, mandatory). Service method UpdateAppPolicy at download_service.go:674-691.

evidence.title: release_id in artifact commit handler
evidence.description: CommitArtifactRequest struct at download_hosting.go:741-755 includes ReleaseID field (line 751). CommitArtifact function at lines 757-840 stores release_id in INSERT (line 795) and handles it in ON CONFLICT clause (line 803).

evidence.title: S2D integration NOT implemented (Phase 3 gap)
evidence.description: scenario-to-desktop upload flow is unchanged. UploadRequest struct (lpbs_client.go:76-84) lacks release_id and channel fields. proxyPresign and proxyApply methods don't pass these to LPBS. DeployConfig (types.go:227-243) has no channel field. This is the primary gap preventing full plan completion.

evidence.title: Verification endpoint has zero test coverage
evidence.description: handleUpdateVerify (update_handlers.go:231-283) is a new endpoint with no test. Missing: lightweight verification match/mismatch tests, deep mode S3 HEAD and presign tests. This was explicitly required in the plan's testing matrix.

evidence.title: release_id round-trip test missing
